brief:
Three Palestinians were shot by Israeli occupation forces on Saturday in al-Ram, a town north of occupied Jerusalem, the Shehab Wire reported. The identities of the wounded were not disclosed in initial reports.

Details on how the shooting occurred and the medical condition of the three remained unclear as of Saturday. Israeli military operations in areas north of Jerusalem have been a recurring source of Palestinian casualties in recent months.
